name: matrix-rain-saver
description: Matrix rain screensaver and X11 screen locker that decodes headlines out of the falling code. Python + moderngl, custom Cyrillic Matrix typeface, xsecurelock + PAM.
readme_summary: This repository provides a Matrix rain screensaver and a full-featured X11 screen locker. It decodes headlines from news sources or custom SQLite databases, displaying them within the falling code with custom Cyrillic typography. The screen locker integrates with xsecurelock and PAM for system password authentication.
key_features: Matrix rain screensaver with headline decoding
Headline extraction from SQLite databases or built-in phrases
Full-featured screen locker using xsecurelock and PAM
Bloom effect and customizable color palettes
primary_use_case: A visually striking and functional screen locker and screensaver for Linux X11 environments that displays decoded headlines within a Matrix rain effect.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, glowing green digital waterfall cascading down a dark, futuristic screen. Within the falling streams of code, clear, legible Cyrillic characters are subtly forming into a news headline. In the foreground, a small, elegant lock icon is integrated into the digital rain, with a faint 'SYSTEM FAILURE' text overlayed on a stylized password input field. The overall mood is mysterious and high-tech, with subtle bloom effects around the forming text and the lock icon. The scene should evoke the idea of information being revealed and secured within a digital stream. 3D render, cinematic lighting, dark background, vibrant green and subtle blue accents.

name: MagicMirror
description: MagicMirror² is an open source modular smart mirror platform. With a growing list of installable modules, the MagicMirror² allows you to convert your hallway or bathroom mirror into your personal assistant.
readme_summary: MagicMirror² is an open-source, modular smart mirror platform built with Electron. It allows users to transform a regular mirror into a personal assistant by displaying customizable information through various installable modules.
key_features: Open source modular smart mirror platform
Electron application wrapper (no separate web server/browser needed)
primary_use_case: To create a personalized smart mirror that displays information and acts as a digital assistant.
cover_image_prompt: A person looking into a mirror, which is not reflecting their image but instead displaying a vibrant, organized dashboard of information: weather icons, calendar appointments, news headlines, and a clock. The mirror's surface subtly glows with digital energy. Small, translucent data streams flow from a nearby minimalist computer into the mirror. The overall scene is a cozy, modern room, with the mirror being the central focus. The style should be a clean, 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a color palette emphasizing blues, whites, and subtle digital glows, clearly showing the transformation of a mirror into an information hub.

name: rdn
readme_summary: rdn is a modern terminal file manager written in Rust, inspired by the classic Dos Navigator. It offers a two-panel interface with essential file operations, a built-in viewer, search, and sorting capabilities, all within a familiar DOS-accurate color theme.
primary_use_case: A terminal-based file manager for navigating and manipulating files and directories.
cover_image_prompt: A vintage-style computer terminal screen displaying a dual-pane file explorer interface, reminiscent of old DOS applications. On the left pane, files are neatly organized, while the right pane shows a file being previewed in a simple text viewer. A subtle, glowing cursor highlights a file in the left pane. The overall aesthetic should evoke nostalgia for classic computing, with a dark background and vibrant, retro-colored text and borders. Small, abstract digital particles flow between the two panes, symbolizing data transfer and file operations. The 'rdn' logo is subtly integrated into the terminal's header. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, retro-futuristic feel, emphasizing clarity and ease of use.

name: free-coding-models
description: Find, benchmark and install in CLI 170+ FREE coding LLM models across 15+ providers in real time
readme_summary: free-coding-models is a command-line tool that helps users discover, benchmark, and install over 170 free coding Large Language Models (LLMs) from more than 20 providers. It provides real-time performance metrics like latency and a stability score to help users select the best model for their needs and integrates directly with various coding tools.
key_features: Discover and benchmark 170+ free coding LLMs
Install models directly into coding tools
Offers TUI, Web Dashboard, Agent Extensions, and a local OpenAI-compatible daemon
primary_use_case: To enable developers to quickly find, evaluate, and deploy the most performant and reliable free coding LLMs for their development workflows.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic marketplace where a skilled artisan is rapidly assembling intricate, glowing robotic arms (representing LLMs) from various colorful components (representing providers). The artisan uses a magical, multi-faceted lens to inspect each arm, with some arms glowing green for stability and others showing red warning lights for latency spikes. Small, holographic screens around the artisan display real-time performance data like speed and reliability scores. The overall scene is vibrant and dynamic, conveying speed and informed selection. The art style is a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a bright, optimistic color palette, subtly featuring the 'free-coding-models' name on a workbench sign.

name: siyuan
description: An open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace where humans and AI agents work together 开源、隐私优先、自托管的知识工作空间，让人与智能体在此协作
readme_summary: SiYuan is an open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace designed for individuals and AI agents to collaborate. It functions as a local-first application, supporting Markdown, S3, PDF, and WebDAV for data storage and synchronization, enabling users to build personal knowledge bases and digital gardens.
key_features: Knowledge graph and digital garden capabilities
primary_use_case: To provide a secure, self-hosted environment for users to organize, manage, and connect their knowledge, with integrated AI capabilities for enhanced productivity and insight generation.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast, interconnected library where books transform into glowing digital nodes. The librarian uses a magnifying glass to reveal hidden connections between books, symbolizing the knowledge graph. Small, friendly AI robots assist by fetching specific books and projecting holographic summaries. Data streams, represented by subtle glowing particles, flow between the books and the AI agents. The repository name 'SiYuan' is subtly etched on a wooden desk in the foreground. The scene is set in a warm, inviting study with soft, natural light, rendered in a detailed 3D isometric illustration style.
